# Abdullah Mohamed

> Senior software engineer in Cairo, Egypt (GMT+2). Builds full-stack web apps
> (React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL), real-time AI features (streaming chat,
> voice STT/TTS over WebSocket), and Flutter mobile apps end to end — frontend,
> backend, and the infrastructure they run on. Shipping production software
> since 2022 at four companies; 10+ apps in the App Store and Google Play.
> B.Sc. Computer Science & AI, Helwan University (2023). Available for freelance and
> contract work with US, EU, and Gulf teams, and open to senior product roles
> (remote first). Works in English and Arabic; builds bilingual, RTL-ready
> products.

## Services and starting prices (USD, negotiable by scope; fixed price per project, not hourly)
- SaaS / full multi-tenant system — from $6,000
  https://www.abdullahmohamed.dev/services/saas-development/
- Web app or internal tool — from $3,500
  https://www.abdullahmohamed.dev/services/web-app-development/
- Real-time AI feature (streaming chat, STT/TTS) — from $3,000
  https://www.abdullahmohamed.dev/services/ai-integration/
- Flutter mobile app, iOS + Android from one codebase — from $5,000
  https://www.abdullahmohamed.dev/services/flutter-app-development/

Every project starts with a free call and a written proposal (price, timeline,
payment phases) that the client approves before any work begins. The client
owns the code.

## Stack
React, Next.js, SvelteKit, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Redis,
WebSocket, Azure OpenAI, AWS, Docker, Nginx, CI/CD, Flutter/Dart.

## Selected work
- Faheem — Arabic AI tutoring platform for Egypt's Ministry of Education.
  200,000+ K-12 students, 8,500+ MAU. Real-time voice-to-voice tutoring over
  WebSocket with Azure OpenAI streaming.
- Talia — multi-tenant national LMS + SIS (25 modules, 534 requirements),
  SvelteKit 5 + Go/REST, RBAC across a Ministry→School tree.
- Xera Lab — full-stack dental case-management platform (Flutter Web + Node.js +
  PostgreSQL + Docker + AWS S3), built and delivered.
- 10+ apps shipped to the App Store and Google Play across Egypt, Germany,
  the UAE, and the US.
